description: Healing Herb (약초): a small bundle of fresh green healing leaves tied with twine, a few leaves loose.
Medium Potion (중급 회복약): a stoppered round glass flask of glowing red liquid with a cork and a little twine around the neck.
Ether (에테르): a stoppered slim glass vial of luminous blue liquid with a cork.
Elixir (엘릭서): an ornate small crystal bottle with gold filigree holding radiant golden-white liquid, a faint glow around it (rare).
Antidote Herb (해독초): a sprig of pale green herb with small white flowers beside a tiny clay pot of green salve.
Clarity Incense (청심향): a small brass incense burner releasing a thin calm lavender smoke curl.
Ward Tonic (수호 강장제): a stoppered square glass bottle of green tonic with a small leather tag (blank).
War Drum (전고): a small war drum of wood and stretched hide with crossed drumsticks resting on it.
Powder Bomb (화약 폭탄): a round black iron powder bomb with a short lit fuse sparking, rope binding around it.
Smoke Bomb (연막탄): a clay smoke bomb ball wrapped in cloth with grey smoke seeping from a crack.
Bewildering Powder (혼란 가루): a small open leather pouch spilling shimmering violet powder in a swirl.
Weighted Net (그물): a folded weighted rope net with small iron weights at its edges.
Caltrops (마름쇠): a handful of four-pointed iron caltrops scattered on the ground.
Gold (골드): a small stack of worn gold coins with one coin standing on its edge (coins plain, no markings).
Supply Crate (보급 상자): a small wooden supply crate with rope handles and a sack on top.
Tempered Sword (단련된 검): a plain tempered steel arming sword with a leather-wrapped grip, shown diagonally.
Hunting Bow (사냥 활): a simple wooden hunting bow with a leather grip and a taut string, shown diagonally.
Longbow (장궁): a tall dark yew longbow with a waxed string and a green grip wrap, shown diagonally.
Crystal Staff (수정 지팡이): a wooden staff topped with a clear pale-blue crystal held by brass prongs.
Mercy Staff (자비의 지팡이): a pale ash-wood staff with a small brass sun-disc head and a white ribbon.
Balanced Daggers (균형 단검): two balanced daggers crossed, steel blades, worn leather grips.
Heavy Shield (중방패): a heavy teal-blue wooden kite shield with an iron rim and a plain gold cross-band (no emblem).
Light Shield (경방패): a small round light buckler of pale steel with a leather rim.
Travel Cloak (여행 망토): a folded green wool travel cloak with a simple brass clasp.
Trail Boots (행군 장화): a pair of sturdy brown leather marching boots.
Focus Charm (집중의 부적): a small violet gem pendant on a brass chain.
Steel Greatsword (강철 대검): a broad two-handed steel greatsword with a squared crossguard, dark blue-grey wrapped hilt.
Knight Lance (기사 창): a long cavalry lance with a steel tip and a dark blue pennant (plain), shown diagonally.
Ironwood Bow (철목 활): a recurved bow of dark ironwood reinforced with iron fittings at the tips.
Plate Cuirass (판금 흉갑): a polished steel plate breastplate with riveted edges and leather straps.
Iron Tower Shield (철관 방패): a tall rectangular steel tower shield with a dark blue-grey face and iron studs (no emblem).
Lancer Mail (기병 사슬갑옷): a chainmail shirt with a dark blue-grey cloth tabard folded over it.
Steel Gauntlets (강철 건틀릿): a pair of articulated steel gauntlets.
Runeforged Blade (룬 단조검): a fine longsword whose steel shows a faint wavy forge pattern and a soft cold-blue glow along the edge (no runes or letters drawn).
Twin Sabers (쌍검): two curved sabers with brass guards crossed, crimson grip wraps.
Repeating Crossbow (연사 석궁): a compact wooden repeating crossbow with a brass bolt magazine on top.
Ember Rod (불씨 지팡이): a short dark wooden rod tipped with a glowing ember-orange stone in brass claws.
Shadow Stiletto (그림자 단검): a slim black-bladed stiletto with a dark leather grip.
Merchant Coat (상인의 외투): a folded long coat of crimson and dark brown cloth with brass buttons.
Lucky Coin (행운 동전): a single large old brass coin on a leather cord, plain worn face (no markings).
Windstep Charm (바람결 부적): a small charm of white feathers and a pale blue bead on a thin cord.
Duelist Rapier (결투가의 레이피어): an elegant rapier with a swept brass cup hilt and a long slender blade.
Sacred Flame Staff (성화 지팡이): a white wooden staff topped with a small brass cage holding a gentle flame.
Pilgrim Mace (순례자의 철퇴): a flanged iron mace with a white-wrapped handle and a crimson tassel.
Pilgrim Mantle (순례 망토): a folded ivory wool mantle with a crimson border.
Sanctum Tome (성소의 마도서): a thick leather-bound book with brass corners and a crimson ribbon, closed (blank cover).
Warden Shield (수호자의 방패): a large round white shield with a plain gold rim (no emblem).
Chrism Charm (성유 부적): a tiny glass vial of golden oil hung as a pendant on a crimson cord.
Votive Band (서약의 팔찌): a woven bracelet of crimson and gold threads with small ivory beads.
Cathedral Staff (대성당 지팡이): a tall ornate staff of white wood and gold with a brass lantern head holding a bright flame.
Crown Guard Lance (왕관 근위 창): an ornate guard lance with a steel leaf-shaped head and a dark blue and silver pennant (plain).
Crown Guard Shield (근위 대방패): a great kite shield of polished steel with dark blue enamel and silver rim (no emblem).
League Saber (연맹 기사의 사브르): a fine curved saber with a crimson and gold basket hilt.
League Longbow (연맹 장궁): a tall elegant longbow of pale wood with crimson and gold string wraps.
Paladin Mace (성기사의 전투 철퇴): a heavy ornate war mace of white steel with gold flanges.
Sacred Flame Vestment (성화 법의): a folded white and gold vestment with a crimson stole on top.
Herb Pouch (약초 주머니): a small embroidered green cloth pouch overflowing with healing leaves, soft green glow. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Hawk Feather (매의 깃): a single long brown-and-white hawk feather with a faint golden shimmer. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.

Sage Notebook (현자의 수첩): a small worn leather notebook with a ribbon and a quill tucked in, faint warm glow (blank cover). This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Wind Horseshoe (바람의 편자): a silver horseshoe with swirling pale wind wisps around it. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Twin Daggers (쌍둥이 단검): a matched pair of ornate daggers, one silver one gold, crossed, soft glow. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Shield of Silence (침묵의 방패): a dark round shield of black steel with a smooth silver center, faint cold aura (no emblem). This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Mirror Cuirass (거울 흉갑): a breastplate polished like a mirror reflecting light, soft white glint. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Charm of Clarity (청명 부적): a clear crystal teardrop pendant glowing pale blue-white. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.

Flame Reliquary (성화의 성구): a small golden reliquary box with a tiny living flame visible through a window, warm glow (no symbols). This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Mana Ring (마나의 반지): a silver ring set with a glowing blue stone. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
Lion Epaulette (사자의 견장): a heavy gold-and-black shoulder epaulette shaped like a lion's mane (no face, no emblem). This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.

Alliance Seal (동맹의 인장): a heavy round wax-seal stamp of brass with three colored cords tied around its handle (dark blue, crimson, ivory); the stamp face is plain. This is a unique treasure: give it a soft magical glow so it reads as special.
